mood: Bright, friendly and bite-sized: a sunny desk of colourful puzzle tiles that resets every midnight.

shape.borderStyle: 3px solid #4B2FC4 with a 4px offset hard shadow on cards
shape.texture: confetti dots on a warm cream ground

buttonStyle: Primary is a violet pill with white Lilita One text and a thick darker outline that presses down 2px on click; secondary is a white pill with a violet outline and pink hover fill.
backdrop: Warm cream gradient with soft pastel confetti dots drifting up very slowly (CSS transform only), and a small calendar badge that flips when the day changes.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
